title.text: The density gap in job churn has persisted as churn fell everywhere
subtitle: ITL2 regions, reallocation pooled over each six-year period, against population-weighted density (2021). Same axes in both panels.
Red line = fit across all regions; navy = excluding London. Northern Ireland excluded (job flows only from 2011).
Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS, NRS and NISRA population estimates; authors' calculations.
